# NIST’s AI Risk Management Framework and Its Generative AI Profile

NIST released AI RMF 1.0 in January 2023 as a framework for voluntary use. It aims to help organizations incorporate trustworthiness considerations across AI design, development, use, and evaluation.

In July 2024, NIST published AI 600-1, a cross-sector profile focused on generative AI. The profile was prepared pursuant to Executive Order 14110.

The publications are a broad AI risk management framework and a companion profile focused on one class of AI. AI 600-1 does not replace the framework.
